TaskDescription: Cued right-arm movement task of Pollina et al. (2026): executed and imagined reaching (RE) and wrist extension (WE) movements, single or simultaneous (dual-task) conditions, paced by an on-screen progress bar. trial_type is the condition label as released (e.g. "WE-E + WL-I"); in the paper RE = reaching, WE = wrist extension, E = executed, I = imagined; other codes are not defined in the release. Task label from the release file name.
